integrity: Source models and hard-pinning grounded Laplacian are prior work. The claim is restricted to exact finite-reset affine universality and covariance asymptotics. No independent audit or external originality certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact for an unwrapped finite connected undirected linear phase network with one Poisson-reset vertex. Not a nonlinear sine-Kuramoto theorem; no graph-size-uniform asymptotics or Gaussian stationary-law claim.
title: Single-vertex resetting: exact affine universality and cubic suppression of remote phase fluctuations
